title: General Biochemistry Practical Manual
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a solution of mercuric sulphate in sulphuric acid."
Million's reagent is a solution of mercuric sulphate in sulphuric acid.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a second semester, two-credit unit course for Environmental Health Science students."
General Biochemistry Practical is a second semester, two-credit unit course for Environmental Health Science students.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to detect the presence of lipid in a solution."
Sudan IV Test on Lipid Sudan IV test is used to detect the presence of lipid in a solution.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to provide information about the degree of acidity of a substance or the state of some chemical reactions within a solution being tested or analysed."
Indicators are used to provide information about the degree of acidity of a substance or the state of some chemical reactions within a solution being tested or analysed.

Lipids are the organic biomolecules which are soluble in non-polar solvents like chloroform, ether, benzene, and acetone etc. but insoluble in water.
fib: ______ are the building blocks of protein.
